# Webeazzy

> Webeazzy is a cloud platform for developers and businesses. It runs three products: Strada (backend as a service with no backend server), Begone (AI background removal API) and Device Cloud (connected device management). Strada and Begone have free trials.

## Products

- [Strada](https://strada.webeazzy.com): Backend as a service. A Postgres database, user sign-in and a REST API with a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK, so web and mobile apps need no backend server. Tables start private; per-user row security runs inside Postgres. Records that keep growing (orders, bills, logs) move to low-cost object storage automatically and stay queryable. Includes an MCP server so AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) can create tables, set access rules and connect an app. Free trial.
- [Strada docs](https://strada.webeazzy.com/docs): Getting started, SDK and API reference.
- [Begone](https://www.webeazzy.com/background-remover): AI background removal on the web and through a REST API, with clean edges on hair, fur and glass. 100 free images, then $0.02 per image. Images are processed in memory and deleted right after processing.
- [Begone API docs](https://begone.webeazzy.com/docs): API reference.
- [Device Cloud](https://www.webeazzy.com/#device-cloud): Connected device management: secure provisioning, live telemetry and remote commands over MQTT, staged firmware (OTA) updates and separate workspaces per customer.
